nativeObservation.detail: After opening unread UID 3 in Smart Inbox, the selected message appeared in Other and Seen at the same time. Opening UID 4 removed the retained Other row.
nativeObservation.interpretation: Selected-row retention was intentional, but the renderer deduplicated only within the retained row's original section and exposed the same account-scoped thread again when the authoritative refresh moved it to Seen.

fix.detail: While an opened thread is retained in its original ordinary Smart section, suppress the same account-scoped thread ID from Seen and other ordinary sections. Preserve the Starred exception and the existing 180 ms switch-away transition.
fix.selectionBehavior: The retained thread contributes one visible row and one selected item instead of two.

sensitivity.method: Applied the regression test, temporarily reverted only the App.tsx renderer hunk, ran the exact regression, then restored the renderer hunk.

brokenRenderer.test: App read state > shows a retained Smart thread only once when it moves to Seen

independentReview.detail: The reviewer confirmed account isolation, the Starred exception, the 180 ms exit and Seen reveal, correct selection counting, and deterministic sensitivity against the broken renderer.

rawLogNote: No standalone raw test log was retained. Exact commands, exit statuses, assertion text, and counts were captured in the active task transcript.
limitations: The fixed behavior has not yet been replayed in native run 2a or a later isolated native run.
